# apple_beta_app_review_detail (Resource)

Manages the contact and demo account information TestFlight App Review uses for an app's external testing. App Store Connect creates it with the app and it cannot be deleted, so creating this resource manages the existing one and destroying the resource leaves the current settings in place. Import it by app ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_beta_app_review_detail" "example" {
  app_id                = data.apple_app.example.id
  contact_email         = "review@example.com"
  contact_first_name    = "Rev"
  contact_last_name     = "Iewer"
  contact_phone         = "+1 555 0100"
  demo_account_required = true
  demo_account_name     = "demo@example.com"
  demo_account_password = var.demo_password
  notes                 = "Sign in with the demo account."
}

variable "demo_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Optional

- `contact_email` (String) Email address App Review contacts.
- `contact_first_name` (String) First name of the contact.
- `contact_last_name` (String) Last name of the contact.
- `contact_phone` (String) Phone number of the contact.
- `demo_account_name` (String) User name of a demo account for App Review.
- `demo_account_password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the demo account.
- `demo_account_required` (Boolean) Whether App Review needs the demo account to use the app.
- `notes` (String) Notes for App Review.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the review detail.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_beta_app_review_detail.example
  identity = {
    app_id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_beta_app_review_detail.example 1234567890
```
